caption: The video captures a foggy night view down a wet road from a stationary viewpoint. On the right, a traffic signal glows red above a yield triangle and a blue directional sign on a striped post. A low building lit by warm light sits on the left. A bright, blooming white glare shines through the mist at the center distance and throws a reflection across the damp pavement. Heavy haze wraps each light source in a soft halo. At the right edge, a white vehicle showing red rear lights moves out of view within the first fraction of a second. Once it is gone, the scene remains essentially steady, the red signal, central glare, and road markings keeping fixed positions with only minor flicker from the fog.
relations: A white vehicle at the right edge moves out of view within the first fraction of a second.
The bright central glare reflects across the damp pavement through the heavy fog.
The red traffic signal, yield triangle, and blue sign remain fixed on the right side.
The stationary scene exhibits only minor flicker from the fog after the vehicle departs.
